Masten is an associate professor of environmental engineering in the Department of Civil and Environmental Engineering at Michigan State University (East Lansing, MI 48824–1326, 517/353-8539). Kerr U.S. EPA Laboratory in Ada, Oklahoma. Her research is focused on using chemical oxidation processes to remediate ground water and soils that are contaminated with organic chemicals.
